title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon SuperS: Various Emotion
native_title: 美少女戦士セーラー・ムーン・スーパーズ －Ｖａｒｉｏｕｓ Ｅｍｏｔｉｏｎ－
overview:
A maiden's dream is to be a heroine in love. The miracle of love makes them stronger!!

Based on the Sailor Moon SuperS anime, this is a one-on-one fighting game in which the Sailor Senshi enter a tournament to test themselves against each other. In story mode, pick one of six heroines - Sailor Moon, Sailor Chibi Moon, Sailor Mercury, Sailor Mars, Sailor Jupiter or Sailor Venus - and battle through locations from the series. The Outer Senshi join the fight in other modes.

Win two bouts to take the match, using special techniques and powers from the anime performed with joystick and button commands. Spend points to boost each fighter's attributes.

- Extra single-player mode with characters not available in story mode
- Practice mode with easier special-move commands
- Versus mode with five-character team battles
- 1 or 2 players
